set.name: Export controls on ECAD software for GAAFET integrated circuits (87 FR 49979, August 2022; ECCN 3D006)
set.requirements: Controls on ECAD software specially designed for developing GAAFET ICs (new ECCN 3D006), part of an IFR implementing December 2021 Wassenaar decisions on four Section 1758 technologies [CLM-0409]. The rule was effective 15 Aug 2022 but ECCN 3D006 only from 14 Oct 2022; NS and AT licence requirements per Country Chart. BIS described GAAFET as key to 3 nm and below [CLM-0408]. Extended December 2024 by ECAD/TCAD controls for advanced-node ICs produced in Macau/D:5. Current status not re-checked.

set.name: Entity List designation of Huawei Technologies and 68 non-US affiliates (84 FR 22961, May 2019)
set.requirements: Licence required for all items subject to the EAR, presumption of denial; Huawei plus 68 non-US affiliates in 26 destinations; 38 more affiliates added August 2020. Announced 15 May 2019 [CLM-0135]. Extended by the Huawei FDP rules (2020). Current listing status not re-checked.

New FDP rules for SME (Macau/D:5) and footnote 5 entities, zero de minimis for specified SME containing US ICs, 24 SME types and 3 software tools, HBM controls (3A090.c, >2 GB/s/mm2), ECAD/TCAD and software-key controls, eight new red flags, DRAM advanced-node criteria changed [CLM-0304]. Allied exclusion via Supp. 4 to Part 742 (33 countries; not Korea or Taiwan). Effective 2 Dec 2024, compliance 31 Dec 2024 for certain controls. FDP and de minimis provisions still in eCFR as of 2026-09-01.

Licence requirements for advanced computing ICs (new 3A090, 4A090; 600 GB/s and TPP 4800) and SME (new 3B090) for China; fab end-use control for logic 16/14 nm or non-planar, DRAM 18 nm half-pitch, NAND 128+ layers; US-persons licence requirement (744.6(c)(2)) with presumption of denial except US/A:5/A:6-headquartered end users; two new FDP rules (advanced computing, supercomputer); footnote 4 for 28 Chinese Entity List entities [CLM-0301, CLM-0302, CLM-0303]. Effective in two steps, 7 and 21 October 2022. Amended by 88 FR 73424/73458 (Oct 2023), 89 FR 23876 (Apr 2024), 89 FR 96790 (Dec 2024).

AI Diffusion IFR 90 FR 4544 (published 15 Jan 2025, effective 13 Jan 2025). BIS announced on 13 May 2025 it would not enforce and would formally rescind it (compliance date 15 May 2025), and issued guidance on Huawei Ascend chips and AI-chip diversion [CLM-0309, CLM-0310]. No rescission rule found in the Federal Register BIS rule list through 30 Sep 2026; a law-firm review (Aug 2026) says it remains in the CFR but unenforced.
